normalized_host_errors.meaning: The current surface does not expose the requested capability.
Host approval is required before transport may continue.
The provider did not complete within the bounded timeout.
The host/provider returned an operation error.
Only a labeled subset of the requested result was produced.
Capability or security evidence is outside its freshness boundary.
The host event cannot be bound to the pending request with required evidence.
Provider evidence indicates prior consumption or prohibited replay.
The host cannot prove completion of a receipt-required operation.
The operation is not defined for this host surface.
The host failed without a more specific safe mapping.

policy_boundary: The adapter reports host condition and evidence. Higher-level kernel policy chooses ASK, BLOCK, UNAVAILABLE, or ERROR. approval_required never becomes Blu authorization, and same-session correlation never decides pending-request policy.
